NM CPS Water Classification

A reproducible classification of New Mexico NRCS Conservation Practice Standards into a hierarchy of conservation interventions, and block-group indicators of recorded CPS activity with documented water-related purposes. Prototype for NRCS review, NMSU Spatial Applications Research Center, November 2026.

Intervention hierarchy Water purposes Block-group indicators

Each water-purpose tag lists the standards whose Definition, Purpose or Conditions document it. Solid chips are explicit purposes (strict tier); dashed chips are indirect only. The broad tier adds standards with a generic, unmatched water purpose, listed last.

Presence-based: each CPS code counts once per block group; extent, counts and dollars are not used. Hatched block groups have no recorded CPS activity in the source data (no record, not zero). Block groups 2020, EPSG:26913.
